That thunderstorm last night? It may have just sent a surge through every outlet in your house. 🌩️

**BODY:**
Most DFW homeowners don't think about power surges until something expensive stops working. Your TV. Your fridge. Your HVAC control board. Texas storms, grid fluctuations, and even your A/C cycling on and off can spike voltage through your home's wiring. A whole-home surge protector installs right at your main panel — one device protecting everything behind it. It's one of the most overlooked upgrades we install.

**BODY:**
We showed up to a call in Rowlett last month where a homeowner's kitchen lights flickered every time the washing machine ran. Turned out a shared circuit was overloaded — something that had been slowly getting worse for years. They thought it was a ghost. It was a 20-amp breaker doing the work of a 40. We fixed it in an afternoon. The point is: weird electrical stuff usually has a boring explanation. And a real fix.
